title: Margie Claus
overview: When Santa goes missing Christmas Eve, his wife Margie Claus has to assemble a rag-tag team of long-retired reindeer to rescue Santa and save Christmas

title: Capitão Adriano
overview: Biographical film about Adriano da Nóbrega, a former BOPE officer who became one of the most dangerous and controversial figures in Rio de Janeiro's criminal underworld.

title: Charlie vs. the Chocolate Factory
overview: Years after his famous candy contest, Willy Wonka returns to his factory, where a new wave of "rotten" kids is plotting to nab a priceless chocolate bar.

title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
overview: Sam and Sadie meet as children and reunite as adults to create video games, finding an intimacy in digital storytelling that eludes them in their real lives.

title: Train
overview: Seventeen-year-old Katie Thompson can see ghosts, a terrifying curse triggered by her brother's tragic death. To help her heal, Katie's exhausted parents send her to a recovery center. This forces Katie and her estranged mother, Tami, onto a long-distance train to Washington. As old family tensions flare, Katie receives ghostly warnings of a sinister presence on board. Tami is skeptical at first. However, she must soon face the truth about her daughter's gift and the darkness around them. Now, mother and daughter must confront their past and the paranormal before this deadly train ride ends.

title: Please
overview: In 1870s, Long Island, a woman's urgent attempt to cure her hidden infertility leads to an unexpected revelation: she never wanted children at all. Armed with this truth, she must challenge her husband to claim her independence.
